title: Banking AI Native - Agent Engineer
descriptionText:
We are One Team. We make it happen. We are Unstoppable.

BABEL es una consultora tecnológica multinacional especializada en aplicar sus servicios y conocimiento tecnológico en los procesos de aceleración digital de sus clientes, grandes empresas y organismos públicos.

¿Cuál es nuestro plan estratégico?

¡Miramos hacia el futuro! Nuestro plan estratégico Hiperespacio 2029 promete ser un viaje emocionante, lleno de oportunidades para crecer y desarrollarse profesionalmente. Alcanzar 1000 millones de facturación, un reto que estamos seguros de que con la colaboración y el talento de nuestra gente, será otra historia de éxito que escribiremos juntos y juntas.

¿Qué buscamos?

Nueva oportunidad: Senior Full Stack – Agent Engineer

Buscamos un/a perfil Senior Full Stack Developer con interés y experiencia en Inteligencia Artificial para participar en proyectos innovadores centrados en agentes de IA y arquitecturas multiagente.

Diseñar, desarrollar y evolucionar soluciones basadas en agentes de IA, ayudando a transformar productos y arquitecturas hacia modelos AI Native.

Diseñar y gestionar flujos de trabajo impulsados por agentes de IA.

title: Senior Backend Engineer
descriptionText:
Adwake is a tech-enabled services company powered by Entravision. We combine data-driven insights, machine learning, digital media capabilities, and performance platforms, including Playback Rewards, the next-generation loyalty and rewards platform. Our mission is to help users discover new games & apps and get to earn real rewards for completing different tasks and milestones. While on the opposite side , we help mobile developers connect with new and engaged audiences.

The Role in a Nutshell

We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to help build and scale the platform behind our consumer rewards and offerwall products. You will work on a cloud-native, event-driven backend on Google Cloud, where reliability, correctness and fraud prevention matter as much as speed of delivery.

You will own features end to end, from APIs and integrations with marketing and payment partners to the infrastructure they run on. You will work closely with product, operations and partner teams, and help shape the platform's architecture as it grows.

Key Responsibilities
Design, build and maintain NestJS services and REST APIs for the rewards app, the offerwall, partner integrations and internal tooling.
Build and scale asynchronous, event-driven workflows using Pub/Sub, Eventarc, Cloud Functions and BullMQ/Redis queues.
